posts.t:
I learned this from milkeyway.

My understanding: ITs want to buy or sell. They have big money. Their orders are gigantic in size. When some of their orders get filled, prices move BIG TIME. Their executed partial orders are distinctly visible in the price charts. They want more money. They have a problem: They need more willing buyers/sellers to fill their orders. What do they do? Trick retail traders. One of the ways they do that is to feed on break out momentum traders.

ITs main concern: finding liquidity to fill their side.

I hope I am in the right direction when it comes to this.
posts.fa:
این را از milkeyway یاد گرفتم.

درک من: ITs می‌خواهند بخرند یا بفروشند. پول بزرگی دارند. سفارش‌هایشان در اندازه عظیم هستند. وقتی بعضی از سفارش‌هایشان پر می‌شود، قیمت‌ها به‌شدت حرکت می‌کنند. سفارش‌های جزئی اجراشده‌شان به‌وضوح در چارت‌های قیمتی قابل‌مشاهده است. می‌خواهند پول بیشتری. مشکلی دارند: به خریداران/فروشندگان مایل بیشتری برای پر کردن سفارش‌هایشان نیاز دارند. چه می‌کنند؟ روی خرده‌معامله‌گران حقه می‌زنند. یکی از راه‌هایی که این کار را می‌کنند، تغذیه روی تریدرهای مومنتومِ شکست است.

نگرانی اصلی ITs: یافتن نقدینگی برای پر کردن سمتشان.

امیدوارم در این مورد در مسیر درست هستم.

posts.t:
It was stressing me out that it was a failed trade.

I was doing laundry and came back to my laptop and saw price sitting inside a lower demand level. I think that flag breaking down was a bear trap. FO to lower demand and ITs feed on momentum break out traders. I bought again.

I noticed in the chart I wrote bull trap. CORRECTION: I meant bear trap.

While I was doing my laundry I thought about my feelings after that trade. I felt frustrated again. Then I thought, each failureresult ONLY means FEEDBACK and I can adapt my thinking into what the ITs really want to convey.

If my perception of the ITs is wrong, then there's always another opportunity to re-analyze what the ITs intentions.

Thanks for sharing. I was thinking something along the same lines this morning. After feeling these same feelings of frustration and disappointment more times than I can remember, I realised that these feelings were having an impact on how i see the market.

I become closed of to seeing things, just focusing on how hard this is. I made a decision this morning that instead I'll notice and accept these feelings, but then move on quickly to learn about why things went wrong. So far it's working and I managed to feel quite positive today.....

I know the road ahead is long but why sit and sulk after each speed bump. Keep moving and you will get to your destination quicker.

می‌دانم جاده پیش‌رو طولانی است اما چرا بعد از هر دست‌انداز بنشینی و دلخوری. به حرکت ادامه بده و زودتر به مقصدت می‌رسی.
